role: Keeps a mob swimming: while in water (or lava) it jumps on an 80% draw each tick; its constructor also turns on the navigator's canSwim.

members.name: theEntity
members.note: folded: the task runs on the owning struct living; the constructor's effect is nav.can_swim = 1 in ai_setup_kind

members.name: EntityAISwimming
members.note: registered as AIC_SWIMMING, priority 0, mutex 4, for every kind that has tasks

members.name: updateTask
members.note: nextFloat() < 0.8F sets the jump helper's isJumping

notes: Java has no resetTask; the native ai_reset has no AIC_SWIMMING case either.
